title: Simple Friend Finder
description: Only one item to help you find your friends (or enemies) on the server.
body:
## Friend Finder Item

![Friend Finder Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/UcRCznd2/images/d6faebff816dc042d69136e080b0f445bdd46218.jpeg)

## Usage:
Shift + Right-click on another player to bind the Friend Finder to them. Right-click to make your bound player glow for 8 seconds.

![Friend Finder In Use](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/UcRCznd2/images/9942b18fa67ed9f034f24036fae8b02f3a22244a.gif)

## This is my first mod ever.
I've always wanted an item like this, but I haven't found a single one that applies a glow effect to another player, just compasses or other some special HUD effects that don't really fit in vanilla Minecraft.
